benefits_summary: Accidental insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or full disability and ₹1,00,000 for partial disability at a premium of just ₹20 per year.
exclusions: Persons aged below 18 or above 70 years
Applicants without an active savings bank or post office account
application_steps: Log into your internet banking portal or visit your bank branch.
Fill out the PMSBY auto-debit consent form for ₹20 annual deduction.
Receive your certificate of accidental insurance cover.
